accessToken.description: Current opaque WhaleU access token; school management checks true current grants.

post.description: Creates a real unprivileged applicant draft. All mandatory images must be uploaded and independently reviewed before submission.

get.description: Actual target-scoped management and own unapproved applications. Cosmetic titles and accepted directory snapshots never grant management.
Separately paginated native approval source. Does not claim legacy accepted coverage or totals. Current home-region gates and exact Media Review apply.
Native approved content only. Manager contact image, applicants and private account identifiers are never exposed.
Owner historical receipt only; replay never restores a revoked management grant.
Fixed school-admin region, or explicit true-super-admin target region. Developer grants do not qualify.

post.description: Exact revision and authority-version CAS. Approved edits preserve approved status as in legacy; every replaced image still requires independent current Safety Review.
Owner/admin/school authority may add/remove administrators but never remove an owner. Transfer requires owner or exact school authority and atomically revokes the real previous owner.

get.description: Exact existing public profile identifier, revalidated against the organization own region. No guessed numeric legacy UID mapping.

post.description: First approval atomically grants the sole owner role to the actual applicant. Reject requires a reason. Business approval cannot replace image Safety Review.
